description: This file implements the DirectoryLister class for listing directory contents, including sorting and cancellation features, within the net namespace.

classes.name: DirectoryLister
classes.description: Manages directory listing operations, including starting, cancelling, and delegating file list results.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::Core
classes.description: Handles the core logic of directory enumeration, sorting, and cancellation.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Start
methods.description: Initiates the directory listing process on a background thread.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing directory listing operation.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::OnListFile
methods.description: Callback invoked for each file found during listing, delegates to the user-provided delegate.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::OnListDone
methods.description: Callback invoked when directory listing is complete, delegates to the user-provided delegate.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Core::Start
methods.description: Performs the actual directory enumeration, sorts results, and posts completion.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Core::CancelOnOriginSequence
methods.description: Sets a flag to cancel ongoing enumeration.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Core::DoneOnOriginSequence
methods.description: Finalizes the listing, calls delegate methods with results or errors.
